ops.summary: Read a score file, validate it against the score schema, and report title, part, event, and measure counts.
Read a score file and emit the canonical, idempotent score serialization with reduced fractions.
Read a score file and run every registered mechanical validator, returning the findings list.

validators.summary: Every part must fill every measure up to the length of the longest part; gaps and empty measures are findings.
Events within a part must not overlap in time or duplicate an earlier event.
Pitches must sit inside the part's declared range; a missing range produces a visible info skip.
